criteria.criterion: A full band whose last item is in-window is split and its own items are not stored.
criteria.plannedImplementation: SoldBackfillPlanner.Resolve: when the page is full (>=100 listings), the reported total is >100, and the last item's resolved sold date is still inside the window, and the band can still split (PriceBand.CanSplit), the planner returns a Split decision. MercariPriceBandCollector's backfill branch enqueues the band's children on Split and does not call MergeAndCountNew for that band's own page.
criteria.evidence: dotnet test tests/MarketMakerEtl.Tests.Unit --filter FullyQualifiedName~SoldBackfillPlannerTests|FullyQualifiedName~MercariPriceBandCollectorTests: both named tests pass (part of the 266/266 passing Unit run).

criteria.criterion: The cutoff search stores exactly the in-window items even with 2-3 out-of-order dates next to the boundary.
criteria.plannedImplementation: SoldBackfillPlanner.FindCutoff runs a binary search over the page (anchored on the already-known in-window first item and out-of-window last item), then ProbeMargin re-checks every position within +/-3 of the binary search's approximate boundary and takes one past the last in-window position seen in that probed range, so 2-3 local inversions at the boundary cannot cause an off-by-N truncation.
criteria.plannedVerification: SoldBackfillPlannerTests.Should_find_the_cutoff_tolerant_of_a_few_out_of_order_dates_near_the_boundary builds a page with 2 swapped dates straddling the true cutoff and asserts the stored count matches the true in-window count exactly; MercariPriceBandCollectorTests.Should_store_only_the_in_window_items_for_a_partial_band_even_with_local_order_inversions_near_the_boundary re-verifies the same scenario end to end through the collector.
criteria.evidence: Both named tests pass in the 266/266 Unit run. Manually traced the binary search + probe over offsets [1,5,3,7,9,11,17,19,21,23] days with a 15-day cutoff: true in-window set is indices 0-5 (6 items); the algorithm returns cut=6 despite the transposed 5/3 pair, matching the assertion.

criteria.criterion: Trading/no-date items are treated as in-window.
criteria.plannedImplementation: SoldBackfillPlanner.ResolveSoldDate: an item page with Status=='Sold' (covers Mercari's 'trading' and 'sold_out' states) but no parsable SoldDate resolves to DateTime.UtcNow (always inside a positive-day window). An item with no usable date at all (no status match, fetch failure, or a null/blank SoldDate on a non-sold item) resolves to null, and IsBeforeCutoff(null) is false, so null is always treated as in-window.
criteria.evidence: Both named tests pass in the 266/266 Unit run.

criteria.criterion: A job with existing sold listings uses the existing incremental pruning path, not backfill.
criteria.plannedImplementation: SearchPageService only builds a SoldBackfillPlanner when sold && knownSoldListingIds.Count == 0; otherwise it passes MercariCollectionSettings.Backfill = null, and MercariPriceBandCollector's loop only takes the date-driven branch when settings.Backfill is not null, leaving the original ShouldSplit/pruneKnownBands logic completely untouched for every other call.
criteria.plannedVerification: MercariPriceBandCollectorTests.Should_use_the_existing_incremental_pruning_path_when_the_job_already_has_sold_listings configures settings.Backfill with a real (non-null) planner but calls Collect with a non-empty knownSoldListingIds set, then asserts the pruning counters populate exactly as in the pre-existing non-backfill pruning test AND that summary.BackfillCutoffUtc is null, proving the configured planner was bypassed. SearchPageServiceTests.Should_not_record_a_backfill_window_issue_on_a_later_incremental_run covers the same branch one layer up.
criteria.evidence: Both named tests pass in the 266/266 Unit run.

criteria.criterion: Scope item 5: record a run issue when a band still has >100 in-window sales and cannot split, and record the window/cutoff on the run.
criteria.plannedImplementation: PriceBandCollectionSummary gains BandsOverCapacityUnsplit and BackfillCutoffUtc. SearchPageService turns a non-null BackfillCutoffUtc into a 'SoldBackfillWindow' ScrapeRunIssueDetails and a positive BandsOverCapacityUnsplit into a 'SoldBackfillBandOverflow' issue, both recorded via the existing ScrapeRunReportStore.RecordIssue path used for PriceBandCapHit/SearchYieldedNoResults.
criteria.plannedVerification: SoldBackfillPlannerTests.Should_flag_overflow_when_a_full_in_window_band_cannot_split_further (Overflowed flag) and SearchPageServiceTests.Should_record_a_sold_backfill_window_issue_when_a_jobs_first_sold_run_backfills / Should_not_record_a_backfill_window_issue_on_a_later_incremental_run for the window issue.
materialConcerns: AddBackfillOverflowIssue's own SoldBackfillBandOverflow issue emission in SearchPageService is not covered by a dedicated unit test: reaching a band width where PriceBand.CanSplit is false requires ~9 sequential halvings of a seed band, which is disproportionate to set up at the collector/service level for a non-critical-path issue. The underlying Overflowed decision it maps 1:1 from is unit-tested at the planner level (SoldBackfillPlannerTests.Should_flag_overflow_when_a_full_in_window_band_cannot_split_further).
criteria.evidence: Named tests pass in the 266/266 Unit run; the SoldBackfillBandOverflow wiring itself is a direct one-line mapping from the already-tested Overflowed flag, reviewed by inspection (SearchPageService.AddBackfillOverflowIssue).

criteria.criterion: Scope item 4: count item-date lookups against the run's fetch budget and record them on the run.
criteria.plannedImplementation: SoldBackfillPlanner is constructed with DetailFetchOptions.MaxDetailFetchesPerRun as its item-page fetch cap, shared with the later detail-fetch phase's budget; once exhausted, further lookups return null (conservatively in-window) instead of fetching. ItemPageFetchesUsed threads through PriceBandCollectionSummary -> SearchCollectionResult.BackfillItemPageFetches -> ScrapeRunService's RunCompletionCounts -> a new ScrapeRunEntity.BackfillItemPageFetches column (migration) -> ScrapeRunView.
criteria.evidence: Both named tests pass in the 266/266 Unit run. Migration 20260924131942_AddBackfillItemPageFetches adds the ScrapeRuns.BackfillItemPageFetches column; EtlDbContextModelSnapshot.cs regenerated to match.

criteria.criterion: Scope item 6 (first half, required): ItemDetailStore.GetListingsNeedingDetail orders never-attempted sold listings first.
criteria.plannedImplementation: GetListingsNeedingDetail orders by (DetailFetchAttempts == 0 && IsSold) descending, then by the existing DetailFetchAttempts/Id ordering, so a never-attempted sold listing is always fetched before a never-attempted active one or a previously-retried listing.
